{{Top|leg}}
'''Orange-rated constable''' was one of the ranks of the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]]. The rank was directly above [[Red-rated constable]] and below [[Yellow-rated constable]]. Orange-rated constables served as patrol officers. They generally served in pairs of relatives, and made up the majority of the Brigade.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
